description: Compares two voltages and raises one of three gates, for A below B, A equal to B, or A above B, on each polyphonic channel

params.text: Sets the voltage A is compared at, -10V to 10V; it is read only while the A input is unpatched

inputs.text: Supplies the voltage A is compared at, in place of the A knob; a monophonic cable here is compared against every channel arriving at B
Supplies the voltage A is compared against; a monophonic cable here is compared against every channel arriving at A, and an unpatched jack reads 0V

outputs.text: Carries 10V on each channel where A is above B by more than the tolerance, and 0V on the rest
Carries 10V on each channel where A and B are within the tolerance of each other, and 0V on the rest; with the tolerance left at 0V they have to match exactly
Carries 10V on each channel where A is below B by more than the tolerance, and 0V on the rest

notes: the three outputs carry as many channels as the wider of the two inputs, and with neither input patched they are set to no channels at all, so no gate appears until something is plugged in
menu: A = B tolerance — a slider from 0V to 1V, dragged to set how far apart A and B may be and yet count as equal; it reads as plus and minus the number shown, and is saved with the patch

inputs.0:
bipolar · continuous · polyphonic

unpatched it reads the A knob.
inputs.1:
bipolar · continuous · polyphonic

unpatched it reads 0V.
